title: YouCoded — round 12: the icon, eye contrast across themes, the box installer

steps.path: Taskbar, dock, browser tab, profile pictures
steps.headline: Which do you like? Pick one or both.
steps.notice: P3 with heavy blur and a darker shadow on every side; R2 adds the name below at the same face size.

variants.label: R1 The face
variants.summary: P3, heavy blur, shadow all round, eyes lit from behind.

variants.label: R2 The face + "youcoded"
variants.summary: Same face, name squeezed in below; for big sizes only.

steps.path: Every theme, at taskbar and tab size
steps.headline: Does this fix the eyes' contrast in every theme?
steps.changed: Same eye style. A soft light now sits behind the eyes inside the face, and the small icon files (16–48px) use eyes about 20% larger.
steps.notice: Golden and Meadow, whose pictures are darker, gain the most; the pastel themes barely change.
steps.risk: The face's colours are a little paler in the middle than at the edges.

steps.headline: Which box installer do you like? Pick one or both.
steps.notice: Q2's tilt, lower; a wider opening; flaps hinged exactly on the box's corners; tiny speed traces at the face's sides.

variants.label: S2 Lower still
variants.summary: Widest box, the face only just out.
